[8] (ran2_cr_chunks 38.331, sim=0.4486)
[CR CR5662r1 for 38.331] Reason for change: This CR captures editorial corrections of the Rel-19 SONMDT features. Summary of change: Some editorial corrections are made in SONMDT features procedural text. In addition this CR includes the following changes agreed during the meeting RAN2#133. Changes in R2-2600303 are agreeable and to be merged in the updated 38.331 CR for R19 SON/MDT In section 5.3.7.6, "LTM cell switch failure" is changed into "MCG LTM cell switch failure" UE keeps SPR configuration while executing SCPAC. Clarify the description of distanceFromReference1 and distanceFromReference2, as they are rounded down to the nearest lower or equal step value Add in the field description that the CG-SDT failure causes (configuredGrantTimer, cg-SDT-TimeAlignmentTimer) are unused. Impact

[9] (ran2_cr_chunks 38.331, sim=0.4438)
[CR CR5446r4 for 38.331] Reason for change: This CR is to introduce the SONMDT features in Rel-19 RRC specification by implementing all the agreements related to the Re-19 SON/MDT WI that affects RRC technical specification up to and including the meeting RAN2#131. Summary of change: The following enhancements and functionalities are added to the SON features: RLF report is enhanced to collect information and measurements concerning new scenarios i.e., UE detects failures while being configured with MCG LTM configuration, CHO with candidate SCG configuration or when UE detects failure upon LTM cell switch or due to CHO with Candidate SCG execution. The UE logs the available L1 measurements in case of being configured with LTM configuration and when L1 measurement is performed and available

[10] (ran2_cr_chunks 38.331, sim=0.4399)
[CR CR5560r2 for 38.331] Reason for change: This CR is a correction to the SONMDT features in Rel-19 RRC specification by capturing the RILs up to and including the meeting RAN2#132.
